name: State Machine
description: Interactive state machines: states that play a frame range of a scene, transitions fired by named triggers, typed bool/number inputs with transition conditions, the issues query that lists every broken rule and unreachable state without throwing, the format-layer check over it that FlareFormat.validate runs, the machine, state, transition and input commands, and the player that steps a machine at run time.

relationships.description: states play frame ranges of a document's scenes; validated by FlareFormat
